description: For an employee who worked in several countries between grant and vest: splits an RSU vest or stock option exercise between those countries by workdays (OECD Commentary on Article 15) or the country's own official rule (US Treas. Reg. § 1.861-4, HMRC relevant period, Ireland, Singapore, Canada), then estimates each country's tax and withholding on its share. Tax estimates for: sg, nl, es, de, us, uk, au, ca, ie, in; the split works for every country. Flags where two countries tax the same income (relief by credit or exemption under the treaty); treaty rates and the relief amount are not computed. Canada needs options {"ca":{"region":"on"}}. Every result is an estimate. Returns the rule used per country, official source URLs and the calcbloc.com page. Not yet supported: cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll), and the double-tax relief amount (get_tax_treaties lists the treaty withholding limits CalcBloc stores).

currency.description: Currency of fmv_event and exercise_price (USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD, CAD, INR or SGD). Default USD. Each country's share is converted at the ECB reference rate.

event_date.description: Vest date (RSUs) or exercise date (options) (YYYY-MM-DD): the taxing event.

exercise_price.description: Exercise price per share, in `currency` (required for stock_option; RSUs: any amount paid, default 0).

fmv_event.description: Market value per share at the event, in `currency`.

grant_country.description: Country where the employee worked at grant (Singapore's rule). Default: from the periods.

grant_date.description: Grant date (YYYY-MM-DD): start of the sourcing period.

instrument.description: rsu (RSUs and share awards, taxed at vest) or stock_option (taxed at exercise). Each country maps it to its own instrument; override with options {"us":{"instrument":"iso"}}.

options.description: Per-country options of that country's equity or supplemental module, e.g. {"us":{"filing_status":"mfj","region":"ny"},"ca":{"region":"on"},"de":{"tax_class":3}}; also region and instrument. list_countries with the country shows its options.

periods.description: Where the employee worked between grant and vest, e.g. [{country:"us",start:"2024-01-01",end:"2024-12-31",workdays:220},{country:"uk",start:"2025-01-01",end:"2025-06-30",workdays:120}].

end.description: Last day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD), included.

workdays.description: Days worked in that country in the period. Omitted: Monday to Friday days are counted, and the result says so.

residence.description: Tax residence at the event. Default: the country of the period that contains event_date.

salaries.description: Regular annual salary per country in that country's currency, e.g. {"us":150000,"uk":80000} (marginal rates and contribution ceilings; a missing country is estimated as if there were no other income there).

us_citizen.description: US citizen: the US taxes worldwide income whatever the residence. Default false.

vest_date.description: Vest date (YYYY-MM-DD), the end of the sourcing period, for options exercised after vesting. Default: event_date.

name: calculate_cross_border_equity

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

covered.description: False: the split is shown but CalcBloc has no tax estimate for this country.

taxableAmountLocal.description: In the country's currency (ECB reference rate).

currency.description: Currency of fmv_event, exercise_price and totalIncome.

estimate.description: Always true: every cross-border result is an estimate.

relief.description: Where two countries tax the same income; the relief itself is not computed.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

totalIncome.description: Income at the event (vest value, or the option spread).

title: Split equity income between countries (mobile employees)
